At the vibrant heart of Hayes Valley, this light filled 2-Bedroom, 2-Bath + Large Den corner unit condo at The Hayes showcases an intuitive layout, with desirable floor to ceiling windows capturing peekaboo views of Sutro Towers and City vibes. Enjoy the comfort of your private balcony, a perfect spot to savor your morning coffee or unwind at sunset.. Unit 527 offers a primary en-suite, vast living space, a large den perfect for a home office or second living space, an open concept kitchen perfectly balancing modern design, in-unit laundry, deeded parking space in the secured garage (INCLUDED), and a dedicated storage locker (INCLUDED).

Residents at The Hayes enjoy amenities such as a front desk attendant, access to an expansive rooftop deck with panoramic 180-degree city views, and a built-in barbecue ideal for hosting or simply soaking in the skyline.

Outside your door, the best of San Francisco awaits: walk to acclaimed restaurants like Zuni Cafe, Espetus Brazilian Steak House, Dumpling Home, and Rich Table. Catch a Broadway show a few steps away in the Theatre District, or enjoy live music at SFJAZZ Center. With Patricia's Green, Trader Joe's, and BART just outside your door, this location places the city at your fingertips. A commuters dream, The Hayes is blocks away from 101 freeway, and minutes from Caltrain. 

Please kindly email the Listing Agent to schedule tours or for details.
